founder_ventures.tagline: A professional networking platform designed to connect mission-driven individuals and organizations through authentic communication patterns.
founder_ventures.mission: Building community through authentic connection, amplifying diverse voices, and creating opportunities for collaboration without corporate algorithmic distortion.

key_architectural_contributions.description: Visualizing unseen communication patterns and network graphs through thoughtful platform design and supportive analytics.
Architected zero-exposure privacy models ensuring user identity controls and verifiable credentials.
Designing scalable backend infrastructure for professional networking graphs and decentralized community trust rings.

architecture_compliance.module_separation: Graph analytics separated into web-worker threads for stutter-free canvas traversal.
architecture_compliance.state_persistence: Attribute-based Firestore security rules enforce client-side confidentiality and zero-knowledge badge sharing.

founder_ventures.tagline: A privacy-first, inclusive applicant tracking system and portfolio engine designed for equitable hiring.
founder_ventures.mission: Empowering candidates to show their full potential by coupling objective, deterministic skills-matching with absolute identity security and neurodivergent accessibility workflows.

key_architectural_contributions.description: Custom settings panels letting candidates declare pronouns, preferred names, and request precise testing or interview accommodations (such as screen-reader optimization, transcription, or quiet environments).
A robust, multi-tier privacy system allowing candidates to generate public share links while selectively redacting personally identifiable details from non-owners.
An automated objective parsing engine that parses unstructured resume data and calculates accurate job matching coefficients.
Real-time, debounced database synchronization on switches and input states, eliminating friction and providing an offline-first feeling.

architecture_compliance.module_separation: Highly modular architecture using decoupled panel files (PersonalInfoEditor, DeiAccommodationsEditor, ExperienceEditor) to minimize token footprint and enforce isolation.
architecture_compliance.state_persistence: State is managed with clean React Hooks and instantly persisted to Cloud Firestore documents key-mapped by Firebase Auth user IDs.

founder_ventures.tagline: An educational quantitative modeling terminal and collective fund simulator aligning inclusive advocacy pods with deterministic options analytics.
founder_ventures.mission: Decoupling complex derivative instruments and Black-Scholes simulators into high-contrast accessible layouts, empowering neurodivergent SRE professionals and mission-driven collective advocates to simulate individual portfolio strategies securely.

key_architectural_contributions.description: Moving high-overhead Black-Scholes metrics and options payoffs calculations to dedicated utility spaces to ensure zero-lag render frames under active telemetry simulation.
Architecting field-level security checks preventing self-approvals, enforcing rigorous audit log trails with automated timestamps, and centralizing error handlers.
Enforcing soft-green overlays ('chris-reading-mode') and customizable serif interfaces for cognitive tracking comfort and reading accessibility.
Enforcing clean server-side encapsulation of Gemini and external API keys behind Express proxy routes, bypassing CORS limits and protecting sensitive developer keys.

architecture_compliance.module_separation: Tab-based modularized routing separates dynamic option calculations and advocacy settings from core dashboard rendering to maintain a lightweight core bundle.
architecture_compliance.state_persistence: Unified responsive data layouts using robust local React hooks synchronized instantly with non-blocking Firestore document stores.

founder_ventures.tagline: A unified investigative graph mapping terminal and FOIA workflow suite for journalists, forensic accountants, and public-interest researchers.
founder_ventures.mission: Transforming fragmented public records, corporate disclosures, and court filings into real-time semantic knowledge graphs to accelerate high-impact accountability journalism.

key_architectural_contributions.description: Hybrid D3-Force layout engine coupled with React-Konva canvas, enabling seamless 60fps pan/zoom across 10,000+ nodes and edges.
Structured generation of federal and state public records requests with automated tracking of statutory response deadlines.
Extracts corporate officers, shell entities, and financial timestamps using structured Gemini JSON schemas to build chronological investigation timelines.

architecture_compliance.module_separation: Canvas physics engine decoupled from document-store listeners, avoiding unnecessary React tree reconciliations.
architecture_compliance.state_persistence: Investigation workspaces stored with immutable audit logs and client-side encryption support.

founder_ventures.tagline: Climate-engineered regional shed and geodesic dome planning terminal tailored for Pacific Northwest environmental loads.
founder_ventures.mission: Bringing aerospace-grade structural reliability calculations and climate modeling into rural and residential construction planning.

key_architectural_contributions.description: Deterministic calculation engine for Western Washington building codes, certifying structures against 50+ lbs/sq ft snow loads and 110mph coastal wind shears.
Calculates chord factors, strut lengths, and dihedral angles for 2V, 3V, and 4V domes with automated lumber cut-lists.
Synchronizes regional lumber pricing and structural blueprints locally, allowing zero-connectivity on-site calculations.

architecture_compliance.module_separation: Truss physics and trigonometric calculations isolated in pure mathematical functions with 100% unit test coverage.
architecture_compliance.state_persistence: Dual-layer persistence with local IndexedDB caches and background Firestore cloud sync.

founder_ventures.tagline: Fine art portfolio, provenance archive, and asset protection system with client-side WebAssembly HEIC transcoding.
founder_ventures.mission: Empowering independent fine artists with enterprise-grade image optimization, intellectual property watermarking, and resilient cloud cataloging.

key_architectural_contributions.description: Converts high-resolution Apple HEIC photos directly in browser memory using WebAssembly, eliminating heavy server compute costs.
Reduces artwork upload payloads by >60% without perceptible loss in color gamut, preserving gallery-grade fidelity.
Automated transparent cryptographic watermarking and context-menu inspection shielding to protect original art assets.
Verifies metadata consistency between Cloud Storage image blobs and Firestore documents on every catalog write.

architecture_compliance.module_separation: Image processing pipeline runs in offscreen canvas workers to preserve 60fps UI responsiveness during bulk uploads.
architecture_compliance.state_persistence: Artwork provenance records stored with immutable version histories and strict read-only public security rules.
